product.preorder_bonus_text: DON'T MISS OUT ON THIS! Pre-Order DLC! Flash back to when the neon burned brightest with the Vintage Vice City Pack, featuring the timeless two-tone ’55 Vapid Stanier sedan and garage alongside the world-famous Ocean Beach, decadent outfits and hairstyles for both Jason and Lucia, and an iconic weapon pattern that echoes the excess of the past. Offer ends 18 Nov 2026
product.description_snippet: Delivery and pickup starts November 12, allowing the game to be downloaded and installed in advance. Grand Theft Auto VI is releasing and becomes playable on November 19.

branding.logo_text: JB HI-FI (black italic bold wordmark with tagline ALWAYS CHEAP PRICES underneath)
branding.font_note: Roboto, arial, sans-serif everywhere (checkout too). Bold 700 headings; product h1 24px/700; section headings are uppercase condensed display type (DESCRIPTION, AVAILABILITY, FREQUENTLY BOUGHT TOGETHER). CTA buttons are square-cornered (0px radius) green #028702 with white 700 18px text ('Pre-order', 'Add to cart', 'Checkout', 'Continue to shipping'); secondary buttons black #000000 with white text ('Review cart', 'Use my location'). Price is shown inside a yellow #FFEC0F price-tag shape with red #E02020 digits. Corner badges: PRE-ORDER purple #812990/white; PRE-ORDER DLC white/black; RED HOT DEAL red; ON SALE, ONLINE ONLY, JB EXCLUSIVE, COMING SOON, IN-STORE ONLY, NEW AT JB!. Panels/modals use light grey #F5F5F5.
branding.header_layout: Row 1: thin black promo strip, white text, rotating messages ('Seen it cheaper? Ask for a JB Deal! Live chat or call 13 52 44' / 'iPhone 18 Pro Out Now! Trade-in & Upgrade! Learn more') with an X close on the right. Row 2: yellow #FFEC0F bar — JB HI-FI logo (links to /) at left; centred white pill search box with magnifier icon and placeholder 'Search products, brands, and more…'; at right four icon+label buttons: Track order, Stores, Log in, Cart (cart icon gets a small count badge after adding). Row 3: black nav bar, white labels, dropdown buttons. On the product page a sticky mini-bar appears on scroll: thumbnail, title, yellow price tag, green Pre-order button. Checkout pages use a stripped header: yellow bar with only the JB HI-FI logo centred, then a breadcrumb Cart › Customer and Shipping Information › Shipping › Payment.

entry.search_url_pattern: /search?query={q} (spaces become +; page title: Search results: '{q}' | JB Hi-Fi)
entry.search_results_layout: Breadcrumb Home › Search results: 'grand theft auto vi'. h1 '20 results for "grand theft auto vi"'. Toolbar: Show: 36 / 72 / 100; Sort by dropdown (Best Match, Price: Low - High, Price: High - Low, New - Old, Old - New, Title: A - Z, Title: Z - A, Highest rated). Left filter rail with expandable checkbox groups: Brand, Price, Category, Primary Format - Games, Console compatibility, Game Genre, Game publisher, Game developer, Primary Format - Music. 3-column tile grid. Each tile: corner badges (PRE-ORDER, PRE-ORDER DLC, ONLINE ONLY, JB EXCLUSIVE, COMING SOON, IN-STORE ONLY, RED HOT DEAL, ON SALE, NEW AT JB!), heart wishlist icon (guest click shows 'You're one step away from having this in your wishlist!' with 'Create account' / 'Log in'), box art, title, platform subtitle ('PlayStation 5' / 'Xbox Series X'), star rating + review count if any, yellow price tag with whole-dollar price ('$129'), optional '+ DELIVERY FROM $4.99' line, optional 'TICKET $99' strikethrough with '$10 OFF^' chip, and a full-width green button 'Pre-order' (or 'Add to cart' for released items; flips to 'Added') or grey 'In-store only' / 'Coming soon'. Footer line 'Showing 20 of 20 results' and price-discount disclaimer '^Discounts apply to previous ticketed / advertised price…'.

add_to_cart.contents: Full-viewport light-grey (#F5F5F5) panel over the page with an X at top right. Top row: green check icon + heading 'Item added to your cart!', then the product thumbnail and title 'Grand Theft Auto VI' with two buttons on the right: 'Review cart' (black) and 'Checkout' (green). Below: heading 'ENHANCE YOUR PRODUCT' with a horizontal carousel of product tiles (title, stars, badge, yellow price tag, green 'Add to cart', heart) and dots/arrow; the two buttons 'Review cart' / 'Checkout' repeat at the bottom. The header Cart icon shows a badge '1'. The page URL does not change.

auth.screen_text: There is no sign-in / guest chooser. Clicking Checkout lands directly on 'Customer and Shipping Information' with a 'Your details' Email field ('Used for your order confirmation and cart reminders'). The only login entry points are the header 'Log in' (auth.jbhifi.com.au) and the PDP coupon row.

options: Delivery (default, highlighted yellow) — shows the 'Shipping address' form; cost 'Calculated at next step'.

Click & Collect — replaces the address form with 'Pickup locations' + detected location ('United States' in our session) and a 'Change location' button. With no stores: red box 'No stores available with your item' and links 'Ship your items' or 'search elsewhere'. 'search elsewhere' shows: 'Cancel', black 'Use my location' button, 'OR', 'Country/region' select (Australia), 'Suburb or postcode' text box, 'Find stores' button. 'Continue to shipping' is disabled until a store is chosen.
Ship to collection point — shows 'Collection point': black 'Use my location' button, 'or', 'Country/region' select, 'Address, suburb or postcode' text box, 'Search' button.
steps.notes: Secondary link '‹ Return to cart'. Country/Region defaults to Australia; State/territory options: Australian Capital Territory, New South Wales, Northern Territory, Queensland, South Australia, Tasmania, Victoria, Western Australia. Address field has a search icon (address autocomplete). Mobile phone has an info tooltip. An 'Express checkout' block with an 'OR' divider sits above 'Your details' but stayed a grey loading skeleton in our session (wallet buttons never rendered). Right column 'Order summary': thumbnail with quantity badge, 'Grand Theft Auto VI', '$129.00'; a discount-code area (skeleton); Subtotal $129.00; Shipping 'Calculated at next step'; Total 'AUD $129.00'. Fields are floating-label inputs with light grey borders.

confirmation.email_sent_text: Not observed. Help pages: order confirmation is emailed; Click & Collect sends an email and SMS when the order is ready; pre-order collections are notified by SMS and email before release day.

account.membership_program: JB Hi-Fi Perks — free membership program (no fee). Help page: '$10 welcome coupon', 'Exclusive member discounts', 'Early sales notifications', 'Birthday Perk', 'Go receipt free'; to join you need 'A JB Hi-Fi account' and 'An Australian mobile phone number'. PDP popup: 'WANT A $10 WELCOME COUPON*? JOIN FOR FREE MEMBER BENEFITS! Valid for 28 days from issue.'; PDP coupon row 'Log in to see if you have coupons.'; some products are 'JB PERKS EXCLUSIVE' (e.g. the $699 GTA VI Vice City Collection). Nav item 'Join JB Perks'.

quirks: Both GTA VI game listings are 'Code in Box' (no disc) at $129 each; JB shows whole dollars ($129) on tiles/PDP and $129.00 in the cart, which is below the AU RRP of $129.95.

There is no Ultimate edition. Other GTA VI SKUs in search: 'Grand Theft Auto VI: The Goodtime State – Vice City Collection' $699 (COMING SOON, JB PERKS EXCLUSIVE, ONLINE ONLY, + DELIVERY FROM $22.99, grey 'Coming soon' button — not orderable yet), 'PS5 DualSense Wireless Controller Grand Theft Auto VI White Limited Edition' $134 (PRE-ORDER, ONLINE ONLY), and the soundtrack on CD $36.99 / vinyl $120 / JB-exclusive pink-blue vinyl $140.

Platform is not a dropdown: PS5 and Xbox are separate product URLs. The PDP 'Primary Format - Games' strip is a carousel of tiles (Vice City Collection $699 / PS5 $129 / XBOX $129) that link between listings.
No quantity selector on the PDP (Pre-order adds 1). The cart quantity dropdown is capped at 5; help explains per-transaction limits to stop resellers.

Adding to cart opens a full-screen modal (not a side drawer) with an 'ENHANCE YOUR PRODUCT' upsell carousel. A separate hidden mini-cart panel ('My Cart' / 'Your cart is empty' / 'Includes GST. Shipping calculated at checkout.' / 'Checkout') exists behind the header Cart icon.

Checkout is Shopify, hosted at jbhifi.com.au/checkouts/cn/<token>/en-us/information. It is guest-first: no account wall, no 'continue as guest' button. Email is asked first, then a Delivery method radio (Delivery / Click & Collect / Ship to collection point) BEFORE the address block.

Click & Collect is chosen inside checkout, not on the PDP. The store picker geolocates (showed 'United States' for our session → 'No stores available with your item'); 'Continue to shipping' is disabled until a store is selected. Click & Collect is free and needs the confirmation email/SMS plus physical/digital photo ID (proof of age for MA15+/R18+).
A third fulfilment option, 'Ship to collection point', searches Australia Post collection points/parcel lockers by 'Address, suburb or postcode'.

Pre-order money is taken at order time. Pre-orders ship from the Victorian warehouse 1 day before release (orders inside 3 business days of release may ship after release), are not eligible for Courier Delivery, and Click & Collect pre-orders are ready from store opening on release day. Help warns pre-order bonuses may only apply to online delivery.
Pre-order price guarantee: if the price drops before release, the difference is refunded after release.
Preload: 'Pick up your copy instore to preload from 12 November' / 'Delivery and pickup starts November 12'.
Strong no-returns messaging on the PDP for code-in-box games ('we do not accept change of mind returns for video games distributed by digital redemption code').
Rating shows 'CTC' (Check the Classification) — not yet classified in Australia.

A JB Perks '$10 welcome coupon' popup appears on the first product page visit and must be closed. Rotating black promo strip above the header. 'Seen it cheaper? Ask for a JB Deal' price-match box on every PDP.
Wishlist hearts on tiles and the PDP require an account ('You're one step away from having this in your wishlist!').
BNPL methods (Afterpay, Zip, PayPal) cannot be combined; Apple Pay only appears in Safari on Apple devices.
Cart shows 'Pre-order release date 19 Nov 2026' next to the line item and 'Includes GST. Shipping calculated at checkout.' No express wallets on the cart page.

gaps: Shipping step (method names, prices, ETAs for this item) and Payment step UI were not observed: reaching them requires entering an email/address, which the rules forbid. Documented from JB help pages plus standard Shopify checkout (marked low confidence).

The 'Express checkout' wallet block on the information page never rendered (grey skeleton the whole session), so the express options (likely Shop Pay / PayPal / Google Pay) are unconfirmed; the cart page had none.
Order confirmation page headline, order-number format and confirmation-email wording not observed.
Login/registration form fields at auth.jbhifi.com.au were not opened (no sign-in rule); listed from general knowledge.
Click & Collect store availability for an Australian postcode not tested (no data entry); the picker geolocated to the US and returned 'No stores available with your item'.
Delivery cost for the game is unknown: neither tile nor PDP nor cart shows a shipping price for GTA VI (other tiles show '+ DELIVERY FROM $4.99'); cart says 'Shipping calculated at checkout'.

No third-party sources (GamesRadar, IGN, Reddit, YouTube): the session's WebSearch quota was exhausted before this task and WebFetch cannot render jbhifi.com.au (JavaScript-only pages, including /policies/ and the Zendesk redirect), so everything comes from live browsing of jbhifi.com.au.
The $699 'Vice City Collection' product page and the Afterpay / Zip / PayPal Pay in 4 help pages were not opened.
